Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Rahul R. Karpe
App for Respondents: Mr. R.K. Ingole.
 Coram : Mehroz K. Pathan, J.
 Date : 4th February, 2026.
2. The learned APP waives notice for State.

3. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is castigated with the responsibility of misappropriation of Rs.
21 Lakhs and odd amount over the period since he had been the Secretary of the Vividh Karyakari Seva Sahakari Sanstha, Rajapur.
The amounts shown to be recoverable and due at the instance of the present applicant were already paid by the applicant on 20.1.2026.

Receipts to that effect issued by the said Vividh Karyakari Seva Sahakari Sanstha,
Rajapur are annexed to the application.
Hence, the applicant may be protected.
4. Thus, taking into consideration the above submissions, I am inclined to protect the applicant till the investigation papers are seen.

Hence, the following order :-
 {2}
 ABA 162.26 SR. 906..odt  ORDER [I] In the event of arrest of the applicant, in connection with Crime No. 431 of 2025 registered with Belwandi Police Station, District Ahilyanagar for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 409,
420, 468 of the IPC the applicant Saklen Yunus Shaikh be released on bail on furnishing PR Bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/-, with one or more sureties in the like amount, on the following conditions :-
